title: Structure Mode Plan Sync group picker for auto-highlight
description:
Force redraw auto-highlights needs an active Plan Sync group. Structure Mode now includes a searchable group list above that button so you can pick the group without opening Plan Sync first. If only one saved group exists, it is selected automatically.

Who is affected: PipeSync Plan View on pipeshare.live (BASE). SaaS unchanged until cPanel apply.

Hard-refresh Plan Sync (map33). In Structure Mode, search/select your group, then Force redraw.
changeLog: Add searchable Plan Sync group picker to Structure Mode panel.
Force redraw uses the selected group and explains when none is selected.
Auto-select the only saved group when none is active.
